assumptions: Price not given; assumed $90 for a 'premium' product.
Margin not given; assumed 70% (typical for beauty) for the break-even estimate only.
Break-even per customer (guidance, not enforced): $90 x 70% x 1.1 orders = $69.30.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $1.50 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

bid_strategy.rationale: Maximise conversions within the budget, never above the $1.50 cap (category default).
